name: rent-cap-spokane
goalText: Enact a citywide 5% annual cap on residential rent increases to slow displacement of longtime tenants.

clarifyAnswers.question: What annual cap on rent increases should the ordinance set?
clarifyAnswers.answer: 5% per year on residential units citywide

clarifyAnswers.question: Which units, if any, should be exempt from the cap?
clarifyAnswers.answer: New construction in its first 10 years and owner-occupied duplexes

clarifyAnswers.question: Should the ordinance include a sunset or review clause?
clarifyAnswers.answer: A three-year sunset with a council review before renewal
